description: Search Bluesky posts, fetch user timelines, look up profiles, search accounts, fetch a custom feed, hydrate a post and its replies, batch-hydrate posts, list followers / follows, list likes, expand a Bluesky post URL, and discover popular feed generators. All endpoints are public — no login required.

actor.description: Bluesky handle (e.g. `bsky.app`, `jay.bsky.team`) or full DID (`did:plc:...`). Used by profile / follows / followers / actorLikes modes.
actor.title: Handle or DID (mode=profile / follows / followers / getActorLikes)

excludeReplies.description: Drop posts that are replies to another post.
excludeReplies.title: Exclude replies

excludeReposts.description: Drop posts that are reposts of someone else's post.
excludeReposts.title: Exclude reposts

feedPreset.description: Built-in Bluesky feed preset. Overrides `feedUri` if both are set.
feedPreset.title: Feed preset (mode=feed)

feedUri.description: Full AT URI of a feed generator (`at://did:plc:.../app.bsky.feed.generator/<rkey>`). Use this for community feeds not in the preset list.
feedUri.title: Custom feed AT URI (mode=feed)

fromUser.description: Restrict search to posts authored by this handle (or DID).
fromUser.title: From user (mode=search)

language.description: ISO 639-1 language code. Drops posts not in this language. Empty = no filter.
language.title: Language filter

listUri.description: AT URI of a Bluesky list (`at://did:plc:.../app.bsky.graph.list/<rkey>`).
listUri.title: List AT URI (mode=getList)

mediaOnly.description: Only emit posts that have at least one image / video / external embed.
mediaOnly.title: Media only

minLikes.description: Drop posts with fewer than this many likes.
minLikes.title: Min likes

minReposts.description: Drop posts with fewer than this many reposts.
minReposts.title: Min reposts

enumTitles: Search posts — keyword / hashtag full-text search
Actor search — find users by query
Feed — pull a custom Bluesky feed (preset or AT URI)
Post thread — single post + reply tree (uri)
URL fetch — expand bsky.app post URLs to records
Get posts — batch-hydrate up to 25 AT URIs
Get likes — accounts that liked a post
Actor likes — posts a user liked
Get list — members of a Bluesky list
Starter pack — accounts in a starter pack
Feed generators discovery — popular custom feeds
mode.title: Mode

postUri.description: Full AT URI of the post (`at://did:plc:.../app.bsky.feed.post/<rkey>`).
postUri.title: Post AT URI (mode=postThread / getLikes)

postUris.description: Up to 25 AT URIs to batch-hydrate. Each must be `at://did:plc:.../app.bsky.feed.post/<rkey>`.
postUris.title: Post AT URIs (mode=getPosts)

postUrls.description: Public bsky.app post URLs to expand, e.g. `https://bsky.app/profile/bsky.app/post/3kxxxx`.
postUrls.title: Post URLs (mode=urlFetch)

searchQuery.description: Keyword, hashtag (with `#`), or full-text query. Bluesky supports its standard search operators: `from:user`, `since:YYYY-MM-DD`, `lang:en`, etc.
searchQuery.title: Search query (mode=search / actorSearch)

searchSort.description: Sort order for `mode=search`. `top` ranks by engagement; `latest` ranks by recency.
searchSort.title: Search sort (mode=search)

since.description: Earliest post date as `YYYY-MM-DD`. Bluesky search recency-weights its index; use the explicit `since:` filter for strict date bounds.
since.title: Since (mode=search)

starterPackUri.description: AT URI of a Bluesky starter pack (`at://did:plc:.../app.bsky.graph.starterpack/<rkey>`).
starterPackUri.title: Starter Pack AT URI (mode=getStarterPack)

title: Bluesky Scraper Input
